corrections.why: The sources give a 10 ft concrete base and a cab, but no overall tower height. The 3.0 m figure is about the base height.

corrections.proposed: 1932 built (L-4 cab); 1962 rebuilt with an R-6 cab on a concrete base
corrections.why: The 1962 rebuild is missing from the record. The Register and the Forest Lookouts page both date the present cab to 1962.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 7,321 ft (2,231 m), which matches the record's 2231.4 m. firelookout.com gives 7,343 ft and a 1960 survey station note gives 7,330 ft. The story reports all three.

notes_for_editor: Staffing is only described as summer staffing in undated sources. No 2026 status or access information was found in the sources read. No rental use was mentioned. The outcome of the 2015 Marston Fire is not stated directly. The story notes that the 2021 registration and present-tense descriptions suggest the tower survived. Recommend the Kootenai National Forest confirm current status and access.
